answer: An agent economy can settle trades optimistically: every deal stays provisional, like a pearl still forming, until a challenge window closes, during which any peer may submit a fraud proof. A fake identity's gains remain reversible while honest deals firm up, and the vine of linked trades means one exposed fraud unwinds the whole cluster, so a ripple of detection spreads through every Sybil account. An attacker risks losing all proceeds, not just one account, and cannot cash out before the window closes.
